summary.text: Maryellen Murphy is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 94, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Cathy Summers is also on the ballot.
A former small-business owner and longtime South County resident, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she would work to keep taxes low and government limited.

paragraphs.text: Maryellen Murphy graduated from Medina High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Baldwin Wallace College in 1979, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she earned degrees in Consumer Economics and Business Administration in three and a half years while working multiple jobs.
She said she and her husband, Jim, spent 30 years running a family business in South County and that Jim is completing eight years representing District 94 in the Missouri House.
Murphy said in the survey that she is a wife, mother of three and grandmother of 12.
She listed her key messages as keeping taxes low and government limited, education and parental choice, and a safe and growing St. Louis.
